notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware, Isaac Sim or sim-backend run was made. The card entry symbol custom_rl_env:UnitreeGo2CustomEnvCfg exists at custom_rl_env.py:321, and the family-config/GymnasiumDriver decision fits the upstream call gym.make(task, cfg=UnitreeGo2CustomEnvCfg()) at omniverse_sim.py:384; no deviation from the card was needed. The upstream task needs Isaac Sim 5.0, Isaac Lab 0.54.3, torch and a GPU (JAZZY.md:61-69), and package code never imports the clone, so the fake backend is this package's pure Python kinematic stand-in (fake.py). It models the policy observation group 'policy' (omniverse_sim.py:407), the term order of custom_rl_env.py:167-186 with 12 joints and a 17 x 11 height scan, the 0.25 joint-position action scale (custom_rl_env.py:330), the 20 ms policy step (custom_rl_env.py:296-300) and the 20 s time-out (custom_rl_env.py:298). NOT COVERED: the Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab sim backend (gymnasium.make of the registered task) was not run; the driver cannot pass cfg=UnitreeGo2CustomEnvCfg() without importing the clone, so a sim run would use the registered task's default configuration rather than the custom action scale and contact termination. NOT COVERED: rigid-body dynamics, contacts, the illegal-contact termination (custom_rl_env.py:255-257), actuator/sensor/noise models and the configured reward sum; the fake's base motion, height scan and reward are placeholders. NOT COVERED: the real Isaac Lab observation_space shape and bounds were not observed; the fake publishes a 235-value policy vector (3+3+3+3 base terms, 12 joint positions, 12 joint velocities, 12 last actions, 17 x 11 scan) and a 12-value unbounded action Box because the clone states no numeric action bound and the joint count comes from the external UNITREE_GO2_CFG (custom_rl_env.py:326). The fake was not compared with an Isaac Sim trajectory; it uses Python random.Random, not numpy/torch. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset); five G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for action_space, observation_space, reset, step and close (the card's native is the config class and the Gymnasium environment interface comes from the external base); G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE (no sourced numeric limit exists on the unbounded action space, so SAFE-014 has nothing to probe while every other CL3 test passed); four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived inputs (seed twice, ticks and action.values). No catalogue extensions were used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest line of the last gate run; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
